build_GVP: build a Geometric Vector Perceptron layer with specified scalar and vector input and output dimensions
build_GVPConvLayer: build a full graph convolution layer with GVP message passing, residual updates, and feedforward
build_GVPConv: build a GVP graph convolution module for message passing on node and edge embeddings
create_GVP_LayerNorm: create a combined LayerNorm module that normalizes both scalar and vector channels of a tuple
create_GVP_Dropout: create a combined dropout module that applies scalar dropout and vector channel dropout to tuples
